facts.fact: Teraco's CEO reported an average annual power usage effectiveness of 1.43 for 2025 across its South African data centres (eight data centres on five campuses).
Teraco reported water usage effectiveness of 0.03 litres per kWh for 2025 in its 2026 Sustainability Report, as stated by its CEO.

Equinix South Africa's MD states its local facilities' closed-loop cooling maintains an average water usage effectiveness of 0.1 L/kWh; the document gives no date for the figure, so the published date 2026-08-28 is used.

Africa Data Centres says it procures clean electricity under a 20-year power purchase agreement for a 12MW solar farm that wheels energy to its Cape Town and Johannesburg facilities; the document gives no signing date, so the published date 2026-08-28 is used.

note: Teraco's 120MW solar PV project (under construction, due Q1 2027) and Equinix's paused Cape Town development are not facts.
